100000.name: Fù (Return) Hexagram
100000.keywords: Prosperity, unimpeded in coming and going, repeatedly returning to its way
100000.coreMeaning: The return of the single Yang line; when things reach an extreme, they reverse; returning to the right path, starting anew.

aspects.事業: Fortunes are rising, re-energize and regain morale.
aspects.感情: Old flame rekindled or relationships repaired.
aspects.健康: Condition improving, gradually recovering.
aspects.財運: Financial luck gradually recovers, can advance with small steps.

100000.transformationTip: Moving Line 1 → Kūn Hexagram; Moving Top Line → Zhèn Hexagram

lines.text: Return before going far, no regret, great auspiciousness.
lines.meaning: Realizing one is lost and returning, quickly coming back to the right path, no regret, great auspiciousness.

lines.text: Auspicious return.
lines.meaning: Following good people to return, auspicious.

lines.text: Frequent return, dangerous, no blame.
lines.meaning: Repeatedly turning back multiple times, although there is danger, there is no major blame.

lines.text: Walking in the middle, returning alone.
lines.meaning: Returning alone to the right path amidst the crowd, admirable and valuable.

lines.text: Sincere return, no regret.
lines.meaning: Returning with integrity and honesty, no regret.

lines.text: Lost return, inauspicious, disaster and calamity. If military force is used, there will ultimately be great defeat.
lines.meaning: Lost and unable to return, inauspicious. Sending out troops will certainly lead to great defeat.

100001.name: Nourishment (Yi)
100001.keywords: Perseverance brings good fortune; observe nourishment; seek nourishment for oneself
100001.coreMeaning: Nourish body and mind, be cautious in speech and moderate in diet; right nourishment brings good fortune, ensure words and actions align.

aspects.事業: Focus on self-cultivation, be cautious in words and deeds.
aspects.感情: Be caring and considerate, express love through actions.
aspects.健康: Pay attention to diet and oral health, maintain well-being.
aspects.財運: Control expenses, live within your means.

100001.transformationTip: Moving initial line → Po (Stripping) hexagram; Moving top line → Zhen (Arousing) hexagram.

lines.text: To abandon your divine tortoise and look enviously at my full cheeks: ominous.
lines.meaning: To give up one's own spiritual wisdom and envy others' physical appetites: ominous.

lines.text: To seek nourishment from below; deviating from the norm in seeking nourishment from the mound: advance brings misfortune.
lines.meaning: To seek nourishment in violation of the usual path, seeking it from below: advancing brings misfortune.

lines.text: To deviate from nourishment; perseverance brings misfortune. For ten years do not act; there is no advantage.
lines.meaning: To violate the way of nourishment; even perseverance brings misfortune. Do not act for ten years.

lines.text: Seeking nourishment from above: good fortune. Like a tiger looking with intense gaze, its desire persistent, but no blame.
lines.meaning: Seeking nourishment from above: auspicious. Like a tiger staring greedily, yet without blame.

lines.text: Departing from the norm; dwelling in perseverance brings good fortune. One should not cross the great river.
lines.meaning: Although deviating from the norm, dwelling in the right path brings good fortune. But one should not take great risks.

lines.text: From whom nourishment comes; peril brings good fortune. It is advantageous to cross the great river.
lines.meaning: Many rely on you for nourishment; though there is danger, it is auspicious. It is beneficial to overcome great difficulties.

100010.name: Hexagram Chun (Difficulty at the Beginning)
100010.keywords: Primal, Penetrating, Harmonious, Persistent; Not favorable to undertake anything.
100010.coreMeaning: Like plants first emerging, a difficult start; all things are hard at the beginning, it is advisable to patiently wait for the opportune moment.

aspects.事業: Initial difficulties in enterprise, it is advisable to seek assistance from benefactors.
aspects.感情: Early romantic setbacks, requires patient cultivation.
aspects.健康: Pay attention to kidneys and bones/muscles, do not overexert yourself.
aspects.財運: Difficulty in capital circulation, prudence is paramount.

100010.transformationTip: Moving Line 1 → Hexagram Yi (Increase); Moving Line 6 → Hexagram Ji Ji (Completion).

lines.text: Hovering, favorable to abide in firmness, favorable to establish feudal lords.
lines.meaning: A difficult start, it is advisable to first stand firm, recruit talents, and then act.

lines.text: Chun, as if hesitating, horses move in platoons. Not robbers, but seeking marriage.
lines.meaning: In a dilemma, seemingly enemies but actually a good match, patiently await the opportune moment.

lines.text: Hunting deer without a forester, only entering the forest. A superior person perceives the difficulty; it is better to give up.
lines.meaning: Reckless pursuit ultimately leads to emptiness; knowing when to retreat is better than brute force.

lines.text: Horses move in platoons. Seeking marriage; going is auspicious, nothing unfavorable.
lines.meaning: Actively seeking assistance from benefactors, setting aside ego to seek cooperation, auspicious.

lines.text: Chun, its fat (richness). For small firmness, auspicious; for great firmness, inauspicious.
lines.meaning: Bestowing favors is hindered. For small matters, adhering to uprightness is auspicious; for great matters, forcing action is inauspicious.

lines.text: Horses move in platoons, weeping blood in streams.
lines.meaning: Extremely distressed, isolated and helpless, crying sorrowfully, needing to quietly await a turning point.

100011.name: Increase (Yi Gua)
100011.keywords: Beneficial to have somewhere to go, beneficial to cross the great river
100011.coreMeaning: Decrease the upper to benefit the lower, widely bestowing kindness; A time of increase, suitable for proactive action.

aspects.事業: Assistance from noble people, significant progress in career.
aspects.感情: Emotional growth, mutual benefit in relationships.
aspects.健康: Improved physical condition, continuous increase in well-being.
aspects.財運: Increased financial fortune, favorable for investment.

100011.transformationTip: Moving bottom line transforms to Hexagram Zhen (Thunder); Moving top line transforms to Hexagram Sun (Wind).

lines.text: It is beneficial to undertake great deeds, supreme good fortune, no blame.
lines.meaning: Suitable for undertaking great enterprises, greatly auspicious with no fault.

lines.text: Perhaps it will be increased, even ten pairs of tortoise shells cannot deter it. Long-lasting perseverance is auspicious. The king uses it to make offerings to God, auspicious.
lines.meaning: Receiving great increase, enduring uprightness is auspicious. The king making sacrifices to Heaven is also auspicious.

lines.text: To increase by using inauspicious events, no blame. Possessing sincerity and acting with moderation, reporting to the duke with a jade tablet.
lines.meaning: Benefiting from unfortunate events, no blame. Acting with integrity and moderation, reporting to the duke or marquis.

lines.text: Acting with moderation, the duke listens and follows. It is beneficial to move the capital or the state based on this.
lines.meaning: Acting with moderation and uprightness, gaining approval from the duke or marquis. Suitable for major undertakings such as relocating the capital or establishing a state.

lines.text: Possessing sincerity and a benevolent heart, do not ask, for it is supremely auspicious. Bestow kindness with virtue.
lines.meaning: Benefiting the people with sincerity, no need to consult or ask, it is naturally greatly auspicious. Bestowing kindness through virtue.

lines.text: No one increases it, or perhaps it is attacked. If the mind is not constant, there will be misfortune.
lines.meaning: No one adds to it, instead it is attacked. If the will is not firm, there will be misfortune.

100100.name: Zhen Hexagram
100100.keywords: Success, thunder comes terrifyingly, then laughter and talk
100100.coreMeaning: Thunder brings shock and fear, be reverent, cautious, and self-reflect; crises awaken, strive forward.

aspects.事業: Sudden changes, maintain calm in response
aspects.感情: Sudden events in relationships, requires calm handling
aspects.健康: Pay attention to liver, gallbladder, and nervous system
aspects.財運: Sudden financial changes, respond cautiously

100100.transformationTip: Changing Line 1 → Yu Hexagram; Changing Line 6 → Yi Hexagram

lines.text: Thunder comes terrifyingly, then laughter and talk, auspicious.
lines.meaning: When thunder comes, one shivers with fear; after the fright, peace and calm laughter, auspicious.

lines.text: Thunder comes dangerously, losing a hundred thousand cowries, ascending to high hills. Do not pursue, in seven days it will be regained.
lines.meaning: Thunder comes dangerously, losing possessions, ascending to high hills. Do not pursue, in seven days it will be recovered.

lines.text: Thunder comes confusedly; acting within the shock, without misfortune.
lines.meaning: Confused amidst the thunder, yet acting within the tremor, without disaster.

lines.text: The shock sinks into the mud.
lines.meaning: The thunder shock sinks into the mire, action is obstructed.

lines.text: Thunder comes and goes dangerously. A hundred thousand without loss, but there is something to be done.
lines.meaning: Thunder comes and goes with danger, though nothing is lost, there are matters that need to be handled.

lines.text: Thunder comes with trembling, looking around apprehensively. Campaigning is inauspicious. The shock does not fall on one's own person, but on one's neighbor, no blame.
lines.meaning: Thunder brings a look of panic in the eyes; campaigning is inauspicious. The shock is upon one's neighbor, not oneself, no blame.

100101.name: Biting Through (Shi He)
100101.coreMeaning: Biting through and connecting, removing obstacles; administering justice clearly and discerning right from wrong.

aspects.事業: Remove obstacles, make decisive decisions
aspects.感情: Face problems, communicate honestly to resolve misunderstandings
aspects.健康: Pay attention to oral hygiene, teeth, and gastrointestinal digestion
aspects.財運: Clear financial obstacles, make clear judgments on what to keep and what to discard

100101.transformationTip: Moving first line → Hexagram Zhen; Moving top line → Hexagram Li

lines.text: Wearing stocks that cover the toes. No blame.
lines.meaning: A minor fault receives minor punishment; wearing shackles that hurt the toes. Early correction can prevent great disaster.

lines.text: Biting through soft flesh, obscuring the nose. No blame.
lines.meaning: Biting through soft things, slightly overzealous, but no great blame.

lines.text: Biting through dried meat, encountering poison. A little regret. No blame.
lines.meaning: Biting into poisoned dried meat, encountering difficulties, a little regret, but no great blame.

lines.text: Biting through a dried bone with meat. Obtaining a metal arrow. Beneficial to be firm and persistent in difficulty. Auspicious.
lines.meaning: Biting through dried hard bone and meat, obtaining a golden arrow. Maintaining uprightness amidst hardship is auspicious.

lines.text: Biting through dried meat. Obtaining yellow gold. Firmness brings peril. No blame.
lines.meaning: Biting through dried meat and obtaining gold. Upholding righteousness, though perilous, brings no blame.

lines.text: Wearing stocks that cover the ears. Misfortune.
lines.meaning: A great fault receives great punishment. Shackles cover the ears, unaware of the need for repentance. Misfortune.

100110.name: Following (Sui Hexagram)
100110.symbolInfo: Upper Dui (Joyous, Lake) ☱, Lower Zhen (Arousing, Thunder) ☳
100110.keywords: Supreme success, favorable, firm and correct, no blame
100110.coreMeaning: Adapt to the times and circumstances, respond to changes; gentle cooperation ensures success everywhere.

aspects.事業: Adapt to the environment, respond flexibly
aspects.感情: Go with the flow, emotional harmony
aspects.健康: Pay attention to oral health and digestion
aspects.財運: Act in accordance with the trend, follow the current

100110.transformationTip: Moving Line 1 → Hexagram Kun (Distress); Moving Line 6 → Hexagram Gu (Decay)

lines.text: Officials have changes, correctness brings good fortune, going out to socialize yields merits
lines.meaning: There are changes in duty, steadfastness brings good fortune; going out and socializing will yield results

lines.text: Attached to a youngster, loses a true man
lines.meaning: Following petty individuals, loses true virtuous people; choices must be made with caution

lines.text: Attached to a true man, loses a youngster. Following, there is gain when sought. It is beneficial to remain firm and correct
lines.meaning: Following virtuous people, loses petty individuals; what is sought will be obtained. It is beneficial to abide in correctness

lines.text: Following, there is gain. Firmness brings misfortune. If there is sincerity on the way, how can there be blame with enlightenment?
lines.meaning: Following yields gains, but steadfastness can lead to misfortune; one must discern with sincerity

lines.text: Sincere to the excellent; auspicious
lines.meaning: Be sincere to good people; auspicious

lines.text: Bound and restrained, then follows and supports. The king uses it for offerings on the Western Mountain
lines.meaning: Being firmly bound, surrendering and following. The king uses this for sacrificial offerings on the Western Mountains

100111.name: Hexagram of Innocence
100111.keywords: Supreme success, favorable through perseverance. If not upright, there will be misfortune.
100111.coreMeaning: Act without pretense, align with Heaven and respond to people; honest and without deceit, naturally auspicious.

aspects.事業: Be down-to-earth, do not resort to speculation or clever tricks.
aspects.感情: Treat each other with sincerity, and emotions will naturally develop.
aspects.健康: Nourish health by following natural principles, do not blindly take medicine.
aspects.財運: Manage finances properly, do not crave for lucky gains.

lines.text: Without pretense, going forth is auspicious.
lines.meaning: Advancing without pretense or inappropriate action is auspicious.

lines.text: Do not plow to reap, nor clear new land for cultivation, then it is beneficial to go forward.
lines.meaning: Do not be attached to the results of plowing and harvesting; let nature take its course, it is beneficial to proceed.

lines.text: Calamity without pretense. Or a tied-up ox, a passerby obtains it, a calamity for the people of the town.
lines.meaning: Suffering disaster without cause, like a tied-up ox being taken by a passerby, implicating the innocent.

lines.text: Perseverance is permissible, no blame.
lines.meaning: Uphold uprightness, then there will be no fault.

lines.text: Illness without pretense, do not use medicine and there will be joy.
lines.meaning: Illness that comes without pretense, recovers naturally without medicine, there will be joy.

lines.text: Acting without pretense, yet there is misfortune; nothing is beneficial.
lines.meaning: Acting without pretense yet still encountering misfortune; at this time, action is not beneficial, it is advisable to wait quietly.

101000.name: Darkening of the Light Hexagram
101000.coreMeaning: Light is damaged, in adverse circumstances; conceal one's brilliance, adhere to righteousness unyieldingly.

aspects.事業: Talent unappreciated, suitable for low-key forbearance
aspects.感情: Emotional obstacles, requires patient waiting
aspects.健康: Pay attention to eyes and heart, avoid overwork
aspects.財運: Financial fortune hindered, be cautious and conservative

lines.text: Darkening of the light in flight, drooping its wings. The superior person on a journey, three days without food.
lines.meaning: Light is damaged, like a bird with drooping wings. A superior person travels three days without food, facing hardship.

lines.text: Darkening of the light, injured in the left thigh. Using a strong horse to save oneself, auspicious.
lines.meaning: Injured in the left thigh, still able to escape on horseback, auspicious.

lines.text: Darkening of the light in the southern hunt, captures the great leader. One must not be hasty in righteousness.
lines.meaning: Campaigning in the south, capturing the chief culprit. One must not be hasty in upholding righteousness.

lines.text: Enters the left belly, grasps the heart of the darkening light. Then leaves the courtyard.
lines.meaning: Penetrates to the core, discerns the source of the darkness. Leaves the place of trouble.

lines.text: The Darkening of the Light of Jizi. Beneficial to persevere.
lines.meaning: Like Jizi, concealing one's brilliance under a dark ruler. Upholding righteousness is beneficial.

lines.text: Not bright, but obscured. First ascends to heaven, then enters the earth.
lines.meaning: Utter darkness. Initially rises high, eventually falls to the ground. Extremes lead to reversal.

101001.name: Adornment Hexagram
101001.coreMeaning: Adornment and beauty, outward brilliance; focus on inner substance, splendid but not superficial.

aspects.事業: Favorable image and packaging, pay attention to detail and quality.
aspects.感情: Romantic and atmospheric, beautiful relationship.
aspects.健康: Pay attention to skin and eyes.
aspects.財運: Small income, do not overly pursue superficial gains.

101001.transformationTip: If the first line changes, it becomes the Li hexagram; if the top line changes, it becomes the Gen hexagram.

lines.text: Adorning his toes, he gives up the carriage and walks.
lines.meaning: Adorning the toes, preferring to walk rather than ride in a carriage, taking simplicity as beauty.

lines.text: Adorning his beard.
lines.meaning: Adorning the beard, dependent on others, moving with others.

lines.text: Adorned and moist, perseverance brings good fortune.
lines.meaning: Decorated and lustrous, long-term adherence to correctness brings good fortune.

lines.text: Adorned and white, like a soaring white horse. Not a robber, but a marriage.
lines.meaning: The beauty of plain white, white horses flying like, seemingly an enemy but actually a good match.

lines.text: Adornment in the hill garden. A small bundle of silk. Regret, but ultimately good fortune.
lines.meaning: Decorating the hill garden, meager gifts. Though there is regret, it ultimately brings good fortune.

lines.text: Plain adornment. No blame.
lines.meaning: Returning to simplicity, using plain white as adornment, no fault.

101010.name: Hexagram of the Family (Jia Ren)
101010.coreMeaning: The family path is upright and orderly, each member maintaining their position; cultivate oneself and regulate the family, from within to without.

aspects.事業: Clear division of labor within the team, each performing their duties.
aspects.感情: Family harmony, stable relationships.
aspects.健康: Pay attention to the overall health of family members.
aspects.財運: Stable family finances, joint planning.

lines.text: Establishing order in the family, regret vanishes.
lines.meaning: Establishing rules at the beginning of family formation, regret disappears.

lines.text: Do not pursue external affairs; attend to domestic duties, perseverance brings good fortune.
lines.meaning: Do not strongly pursue external affairs, focus on domestic responsibilities; upholding rectitude brings auspiciousness.

lines.text: The family is strict, regret is severe, auspicious; wives and children are joyful, ultimately regret.
lines.meaning: Though strict family rules may bring pressure, it ultimately leads to good fortune; excessive indulgence will ultimately lead to regret.

lines.text: Enriching the family, great good fortune.
lines.meaning: Making the family wealthy, great good fortune.

lines.text: The king approaches the family, no need to worry, good fortune.
lines.meaning: The way a king governs the family, no need for worry, auspicious.

lines.text: Having sincerity and dignity, ultimately good fortune.
lines.meaning: Governing the family with sincerity and dignity, ultimately auspicious.

101011.name: Completion
101011.keywords: Success, small advantages, auspicious at the beginning, chaotic at the end
101011.coreMeaning: All matters are accomplished, great tasks completed; think of danger in times of peace, prevent slackening.

aspects.事業: Goals achieved, must guard against arrogance and complacency.
aspects.感情: Stable emotions, maintain freshness.
aspects.健康: Good health status, continue maintenance.
aspects.財運: Stable finances, prevent slackening and squandering.

lines.text: Drag its wheels, wet its tail, no blame.

lines.text: A woman loses her head-dress, do not pursue, it will be found in seven days.
lines.meaning: A woman loses her head-dress, do not rush to retrieve it, it will naturally be found after seven days.

lines.text: Gao Zong attacks the land of ghosts (Gui Fang), overcomes it in three years, do not employ small men.
lines.meaning: Gao Zong conquers the barbarians, only winning after three years; after success, do not let small men gain power.

lines.text: The silken garment has rags, be vigilant all day long.
lines.meaning: Even if clothing is damaged, remain vigilant all day, prevent problems before they grow.

lines.text: The eastern neighbor slaughters an ox, it is not as good as the western neighbor's simple sacrifice, who truly receives blessings.
lines.meaning: An elaborate sacrifice is not as good as a sincere, simple offering; only sincerity brings blessings.

lines.text: Wet its head, danger.
lines.meaning: Head is wet, gone too far, danger; a warning of prosperity turning to decline.

101100.name: Abundance (Feng)

aspects.感情: Relationships are abundant, enjoy the present.
aspects.健康: Full of energy, do not indulge excessively.
aspects.財運: Financial fortune is prosperous, pay attention to changes after the peak.

lines.text: Meeting one's matching lord, even for ten days, there is no blame, going forward has honor.

lines.text: Abundance is obscured, at midday seeing the Dipper, going forth incurs doubt and illness, with sincerity one will be revealed, auspicious.

lines.text: Its abundance is obscured, at midday seeing the Dipper, meeting one's equal lord, auspicious.
lines.meaning: Abundance is obscured, at midday seeing the Dipper, meeting a lord of equal standing, auspicious.

lines.text: One with virtue comes, bringing joyous reputation, auspicious.

lines.text: Its house is abundant, its home is obscured, peeking into its door, it is quiet and empty, not seen for three years, ominous.
lines.meaning: The house is grand and abundant, the home is obscured, peeking into its doorway, it is empty with no one present, not seen for three years, ominous.

aspects.事業: Talents are displayed, shining brightly.

aspects.健康: Pay attention to the heart and eyes, do not overuse your eyes.

lines.text: Walking in disarray, be respectful, no blame.

lines.text: Yellow Li, great good fortune.

lines.text: Li at sunset; if one does not drum on jars and sing, then the lament of old age, misfortune.

lines.text: Sudden arrival, as if burnt, as if dead, as if abandoned.

lines.text: The king goes forth on an expedition, auspiciously beheading the leader, capturing not those of his ilk, no blame.

101110.name: Hexagram Ge (Revolution)

lines.text: Childlike ignorance. Good fortune.
lines.meaning: To study with the pure and innocent heart of a child, naturally brings good fortune.

lines.text: To strike the ignorant. It is not favorable to act as a robber; it is favorable to ward off robbers.
lines.meaning: To correct ignorance with severe methods; it is beneficial for defense, but not for offense.

010111.name: Hexagram of Conflict/Litigation
010111.keywords: Having sincerity, apprehension, middle good fortune, ultimate misfortune
010111.coreMeaning: Disputes and conflicts; it is best to seek reconciliation. Stubborn contention leads to mutual harm.

aspects.事業: Avoid direct confrontation, replace conflict with negotiation
aspects.感情: Constant disputes, requires calm handling
aspects.健康: High emotional stress, pay attention to cardiovascular health
aspects.財運: Avoid legal disputes, sign contracts cautiously

010111.transformationTip: Moving initial line → Hexagram of Waiting; Moving top line → Hexagram of Fellowship

lines.text: Do not prolong the matter, there may be minor words, but ultimately auspicious.
lines.meaning: Do not escalate the dispute; although there may be minor verbal conflicts, it will ultimately be auspicious.

lines.text: Cannot overcome the litigation; return and escape. For the three hundred households in one's town, there will be no misfortune.
lines.meaning: Unable to win the lawsuit, withdraw early, preserve one's small family business, and avoid disaster.

lines.text: Feed on old virtue; persistence is perilous, but ultimately auspicious. Or, if one follows the king's affairs, there will be no achievement.
lines.meaning: Maintain old endeavors without contention; though perilous, it is ultimately auspicious. Assisting others yields no primary achievement.

lines.text: Cannot overcome the litigation; return to one's lot, change. Tranquil persistence brings good fortune.
lines.meaning: Do not force the dispute, return to one's proper place, change one's attitude, and abide by the righteous path for good fortune.

lines.text: Conflict, supremely auspicious.
lines.meaning: Being impartial and just, upholding fairness, brings great auspiciousness.

lines.text: One may be granted a leather belt, but in a single morning, it will be thrice stripped away.
lines.meaning: Though the dispute may be won, the honor gained is lost in a day; conflict ultimately brings no benefit.

010000.name: Shi Hexagram (The Army / The Host)
010000.keywords: Righteousness, Elder (Leader), Good Fortune, No Blame
010000.coreMeaning: Commanding an army, discipline comes first; winning people over with virtue, united in purpose.

aspects.事業: Teamwork is advisable, obey leadership.
aspects.感情: Relationships need to be clear, avoid ambiguity.
aspects.健康: Pay attention to muscles, bones, and kidneys; avoid overexertion.
aspects.財運: Partnership investments require caution, clear regulations.

010000.transformationTip: Moving initial line transforms into Lin Hexagram; moving top line transforms into Bi Hexagram.

lines.text: The army goes forth with discipline; if not, disaster.
lines.meaning: The army must have discipline, otherwise it will surely fail.

lines.text: In the midst of the army, good fortune, no blame; the king bestows commands thrice.
lines.meaning: Occupying a central and upright position, receiving significant trust from the king.

lines.text: The army perhaps carries corpses; disaster.
lines.meaning: Improper command, multiple people in charge, certain defeat.

lines.text: The army encamps on the left; no blame.
lines.meaning: Temporarily retreat, preserve strength, no fault.

lines.text: There is game in the field; it is beneficial to speak up; no blame. The eldest son leads the army, the younger brother carries corpses; perseverance leads to disaster.
lines.meaning: It is auspicious to deploy troops with proper justification; a wise general should be used, not an incompetent one.

lines.text: The great ruler has a command: establish states and inherit families; small men should not be employed.
lines.meaning: Reward merits, establish states and confer titles, but by no means allow petty individuals to gain power.

000010.name: Bi Hexagram
000010.keywords: Auspicious, primal divination, eternally firm and upright, no blame.
000010.coreMeaning: Intimate mutual support, cooperative and gregarious; widely build good connections, treat with sincerity.

aspects.事業: Cooperation for mutual benefit, building connections
aspects.感情: Harmonious relationship, mutual support
aspects.健康: Pay attention to kidneys and blood circulation
aspects.財運: Cooperative financial management is beneficial, pay attention to integrity

000010.transformationTip: Moving Line 1 → Shi Hexagram; Moving Line 6 → Xu Hexagram

lines.text: Possessing sincerity, draw close to it, no blame. Sincerity fills the jar, in the end, there will be other auspiciousness.
lines.meaning: Approaching others with sincerity and trustworthiness, with sincerity overflowing, naturally attracts others.

lines.text: Drawing close from within, firm and upright brings good fortune.
lines.meaning: Sincere closeness originating from the heart, adhering to uprightness brings good fortune.

lines.text: Drawing close to unsuitable people.
lines.meaning: Befriending unsuitable people, dangerous.

lines.text: Drawing close outwardly, firm and upright brings good fortune.
lines.meaning: Widely building good connections outwardly, adhering to uprightness brings good fortune.

lines.text: Manifest closeness. The king uses three drives, letting go of the game in front. The people of the city are not cautioned. Auspicious.
lines.meaning: Openly benevolent, not forceful, following nature, auspicious.

lines.text: Drawing close without a leader. Inauspicious.
lines.meaning: Without a backbone, following without direction, dangerous.

000111.name: Hexagram of Stagnation (Pǐ)
000111.keywords: Obstruction to the ignoble; unfavorable for the perseverance of the noble person
000111.coreMeaning: Heaven and Earth do not connect, all things are blocked; in times of adversity, uphold integrity and await the opportune moment.

aspects.事業: Career/Business: Luck is stagnant, it is advisable to guard/maintain rather than advance.
aspects.感情: Relationships/Emotions: Communication is not smooth, requires patient resolution.
aspects.健康: Health: Pay attention to emotions and the digestive system.
aspects.財運: Financial Luck: Financial luck is poor, be cautious and conservative.

lines.text: Pulling up rushes, by their roots, brings good fortune and success.
lines.meaning: Those of the same kind gather to uphold integrity, jointly facing adversity, bringing auspiciousness and success.

lines.text: Embracing/supporting, the small person is auspicious; the great person experiences obstruction, yet succeeds.
lines.meaning: Small-minded people profit by conforming to the system; noble persons in a state of obstruction can conversely achieve success.

lines.text: Embracing shame.
lines.meaning: Feeling internal shame, acting improperly, requires self-reflection.

lines.text: There is a command, no blame, companions share in the blessing.
lines.meaning: Acting on command, without fault, companions share in the well-being.

lines.text: Cessation of obstruction, the great person is auspicious. 'Perish, perish!' (Be ever vigilant), fastened to a clump of mulberry trees.
lines.meaning: Obstruction ends, the great person is auspicious. Be ever vigilant, only then can the foundation be stable.

lines.text: Overthrowing obstruction. First obstruction, then joy.
lines.meaning: When obstruction reaches its extreme, prosperity comes. First there is difficulty, then joy, ultimately things will improve.

001000.name: Hexagram of Modesty
001000.keywords: Success, the noble person has a good ending
001000.coreMeaning: Maintain modesty and self-restraint, do not dwell on achievements; live discreetly, and ultimately achieve good results.

aspects.事業: Treat people with modesty, accumulate strength and release it gradually
aspects.感情: Gentle and considerate, do not force things
aspects.健康: Peace of mind and body, pay attention to the digestive system
aspects.財運: Accumulate wealth discreetly, like a steady stream

lines.text: A truly modest noble person, venturing into a great river, auspicious.
lines.meaning: A noble person who is modest to the end can pass through even great difficulties auspiciously.

lines.text: Modesty proclaimed, perseverance auspicious.
lines.meaning: The reputation for modesty is widely known; upholding correctness leads to auspiciousness.

lines.text: Modesty amidst labor (achievements), the noble person has a good ending, auspicious.
lines.meaning: Having achievements yet remaining modest, the noble person starts well and ends well, auspicious.

lines.text: Nothing is disadvantageous, manifesting modesty.
lines.meaning: Applying the way of modesty, nothing is unfavorable.

lines.text: Not enriched by its neighbors, it is advantageous to invade/attack, nothing is unfavorable.
lines.meaning: Does not oppress people with wealth, inspires with modesty, even campaigns/conquests are not unfavorable.

lines.text: Modesty proclaimed, advantageous to mobilize armies, to conquer the dependent state.
lines.meaning: The reputation for modesty spreads afar; it can be used to rectify discipline and conquer dependent states.

000100.name: Hexagram Yu (Enthusiasm)
000100.keywords: Favorable to establish feudal lords and mobilize armies
000100.coreMeaning: Joyful and inspired, moving with the current; making preparations in advance, issuing commands to the multitude.

aspects.事業: The time is ripe; you can fully display your abilities.
aspects.感情: Emotions are pleasant, the atmosphere is harmonious.
aspects.健康: Pay attention to the liver and gallbladder; do not indulge excessively.
aspects.財運: Wealth luck is prosperous; you can act proactively.

lines.text: Ming Yu, ominous
lines.meaning: Carried away by success, boasting loudly, will surely invite disaster.

lines.text: Jie Yu Shi, not for a full day, perseverance auspicious.
lines.meaning: Willpower is firm as a rock; retreat early when the opportunity arises; uphold what is correct brings good fortune.

lines.text: Xu Yu, regret, belated regret.
lines.meaning: Looking up and flattering to seek pleasure, leads to regret; hesitation and indecision lead to even greater regret.

lines.text: You Yu, great gain, do not doubt, friends gather.
lines.meaning: People are joyful because of you; there is great gain; do not doubt; friends gather.

lines.text: Perseverance in sickness, always not dying.
lines.meaning: Although there is sickness, by upholding what is correct and persevering, one will not perish.

lines.text: Ming Yu, if accomplished there is change, no blame.
lines.meaning: Indulging in pleasure without realizing it; if one can change in time, there will be no blame.

011001.name: Gu Hexagram
011001.keywords: Supreme success, advantageous to cross the great river
011001.coreMeaning: Long-standing problems have accumulated, requiring reform and renewal; abolishing the old and establishing the new, rebuilding order.

aspects.事業: Requires reform and rectification, solving accumulated problems.
aspects.感情: Old problems need to be faced directly, communicate frankly.
aspects.健康: Pay attention to the digestive system and liver, requires conditioning.
aspects.財運: Organize finances, clear accumulated problems.

011001.transformationTip: Moving Line 1 → Sheng Hexagram; Moving Line 6 → Sui Hexagram

lines.text: Dealing with the corruption of the father, having a virtuous son, no blame, though dangerous, ultimately auspicious.
lines.meaning: Rectifying the accumulated problems left by the father's generation, with a virtuous son to inherit, though dangerous, ultimately auspicious.

lines.text: Dealing with the corruption of the mother, it is not advisable to be unyielding.
lines.meaning: Rectifying the mother's accumulated problems requires a gentle approach, not a rigid one.

lines.text: Dealing with the corruption of the father, there is minor regret, but no major blame.
lines.meaning: Rectifying the accumulated problems of the father's generation, though there are minor regrets, there are no major faults.

lines.text: Indulging in the corruption of the father, going forward will lead to regret.
lines.meaning: Being overly lenient and indulgent towards the father's accumulated problems, continuing will lead to regret.

lines.text: Dealing with the corruption of the father, thereby gaining praise.
lines.meaning: Rectifying the accumulated problems of the father's generation, thereby gaining honor and reputation.

lines.text: Does not serve kings and nobles, upholding lofty principles in one's affairs.
lines.meaning: Does not serve kings and nobles, cultivating oneself with noble aspirations.

000011.name: Guan (Contemplation)
000011.keywords: Washing without offering, with sincerity and reverence
000011.coreMeaning: Calmly observe changes, gain insight into the whole situation; lead by example, reflect upon oneself.

aspects.事業: Observe calmly, do not act rashly for now.
aspects.感情: Observe the other person, act after careful consideration.
aspects.健康: Beware of wind-cold evils, pay attention to overall health.
aspects.財運: Observe the market calmly, wait for the right opportunity.

000011.transformationTip: If Line 1 moves → Hexagram Pi (Stagnation); If Line 6 moves → Hexagram Bo (Splitting Apart).

lines.text: Childish observation. For the small person, no blame. For the superior person, regret.
lines.meaning: Observing superficially like a child; no harm for the petty person, but regret for the noble person.

lines.text: Peeping observation. Beneficial for the persistence of a woman.
lines.meaning: Peeking through a crack, with limited vision; beneficial for those who are gentle and upright.

lines.text: Observing my life, advancing or retreating.
lines.meaning: Observe one's own actions, carefully decide whether to advance or retreat.

lines.text: Observing the glory of the nation. It is beneficial to be a guest of the king.
lines.meaning: Observe the national character; it is beneficial to meet the ruler, to offer talents and serve the country.

lines.text: Observing one's own life/influence. For the superior person, no blame.
lines.meaning: Observe one's own influence and conduct; for the noble person, there is no fault.

lines.text: Observing others' lives/states. For the superior person, no blame.
lines.meaning: Observe the life states of others; the noble person maintains detachment and is without blame.

000001.name: Stripping Hexagram
000001.coreMeaning: Yin is strong, Yang is weak; things are peeling off. Remain still and wait for the right time, adapt to natural growth and decline.

aspects.事業: Fortune is declining, it is advisable to maintain rather than advance.
aspects.感情: Relationship is gradually cooling down, requires careful maintenance.
aspects.健康: Body is weak, pay attention to muscles, bones, and spine.
aspects.財運: Financial fortune is poor, carefully guard against losses.

lines.text: Stripping the bed at its feet, disregarding righteousness, ominous.

lines.text: Stripping the bed at its frame, disregarding righteousness, ominous.
lines.meaning: The stripping reaches the bed frame, the foundation's instability deepens, ominous.

lines.text: Being stripped, no blame.
lines.meaning: Although in the midst of stripping, one can cooperate with those above, thus no blame.

lines.text: Stripping the bed to the skin, ominous.
lines.meaning: The stripping reaches the bed surface, already harming the body. Danger is near.

lines.text: Like strung fish, favored by palace women, nothing is unfavorable.
lines.meaning: Like fish strung together, leading the multitude to submit, gaining the favor of the ruler. Nothing is unfavorable.

lines.text: The large fruit is not eaten; the noble person receives carriage, the petty person strips his dwelling.
lines.meaning: Only a great fruit remains uneaten. The noble person gains public support, while the petty person destroys his own home.

011110.name: Hexagram of Great Preponderance
011110.keywords: Ridgepole sags, beneficial to have a direction to go, smooth success
011110.coreMeaning: Exceeding the norm, overloaded; in extraordinary times, extraordinary measures are required.

aspects.事業: Excessive pressure, strategies need adjustment.
aspects.感情: Overly attached emotionally, need to relax appropriately.
aspects.健康: Overworked, pay attention to lower back and liver.
aspects.財運: High financial pressure, avoid excessive leverage.

lines.text: Using white rushes as cushion, no blame.
lines.meaning: Using white rushes as a cushion, acting cautiously, no fault.

lines.text: A withered willow sprouts shoots, an old husband gets a young wife, nothing disadvantageous.
lines.meaning: A withered willow reborn, an old husband gets a young wife; although unusual, there is nothing disadvantageous.

lines.text: The ridgepole sags, inauspicious.
lines.meaning: The ridgepole bends, unable to bear weight, will inevitably collapse, inauspicious.

lines.text: The ridgepole is firm, auspicious, but there is regret if depending on others.
lines.meaning: The ridgepole is strong and firm, auspicious, but if there are other dependencies, there will be regret.

lines.text: A withered willow blossoms, an old wife gets a young husband, no blame and no praise.
lines.meaning: A withered willow blossoms, an old wife gets a young husband; although there is no fault, there is no honor either.

lines.text: Crossing too deeply, head submerged, inauspicious, but no blame.
lines.meaning: Wading too deeply and submerging the head; though inauspicious, it is for a righteous cause, so no blame.

010010.name: The Abysmal (Kan)
010010.coreMeaning: Repeated obstacles and dangers; break through with sincerity; remain firm in will, survive amidst danger.

aspects.事業: Many difficulties; need firm belief to break through.
aspects.感情: Relationship ups and downs; need genuine maintenance.
aspects.健康: Pay attention to kidneys and blood; guard against cold and dampness.
aspects.財運: Financial fortune is difficult; caution and conservatism are key.

lines.meaning: Accustomed to danger, yet falling into a deep pit, ominous.

lines.text: The Abysmal has danger, seek small gains.
lines.meaning: Trapped in danger, can only achieve small gains; do not expect too much.

lines.text: Coming from the abysmal, dangerous and resting, entering a deep pit, do not act.
lines.meaning: Danger before and after; not advisable to take any action at this time.

lines.text: A jar of wine, two bowls, use earthenware; send a simple message through the window; ultimately no blame.
lines.meaning: Associate with simplicity and sincerity; though in a dangerous situation, ultimately no fault.

lines.text: The abyss is not yet full, but it is already stable; no blame.
lines.meaning: The dangerous pit is not yet filled, but it is tending towards stability; no blame.

lines.text: Tied with ropes, placed among thorny bushes; for three years unable to get out, ominous.
lines.meaning: Heavily bound and trapped in thorns; unable to escape for three years, ominous.

001110.name: Xian Hexagram (Influence)

aspects.感情: Sweet emotions, mutual attraction
aspects.健康: Pay attention to the spleen, stomach, and joints
aspects.財運: Financial fortune improves due to interpersonal relationships

aspects.事業: Persistent and unremitting effort, long-term cultivation will surely lead to success.
aspects.感情: Stable and long-lasting, mutual support.
aspects.健康: Maintain a regular routine, consistent self-care.

lines.text: Regret vanishes.

lines.text: Not constant in one's virtue, perhaps inheriting shame; persistence leads to regret.

lines.text: To agitate constancy, ominous.
lines.meaning: Seeking constancy through restless means, it cannot last, ominous.

aspects.感情: Do not force, appropriately maintain distance
aspects.健康: Rest and recuperation, stay away from stress
aspects.財運: Timely withdrawal, avoid losses

lines.text: Retreating at the tail, perilous. Do not undertake anything.
lines.meaning: Falling behind others in retreat, dangerous. It is not advisable to act at this time.

lines.text: Holding it with the hide of a yellow ox; no one can untie it.
lines.meaning: Firmly bound with yellow ox hide, no one can break free; resolute will.

aspects.感情: Misunderstandings cleared, relationships return to the right track.

lines.text: No blame.
lines.meaning: Just freed from difficulties, calm and without blame.

lines.text: Hunting in the field, obtains three foxes. Gains a yellow arrow. Perseverance brings good fortune.
lines.meaning: Hunting in the field, obtains three foxes. Gains a golden arrow. Perseverance brings good fortune, removing petty people.

lines.text: Carrying burdens and riding in a carriage, inviting bandits. Perseverance brings regret.
lines.meaning: Unsuited for the position yet occupying a high rank, inviting robbers. Even with perseverance, there is regret.

lines.text: Untie the big toe. Friends will then arrive and be trusted.
lines.meaning: Sever ties with petty people (or those who hold you back like a toe). True friends will then arrive.

lines.text: The noble person alone can deliver. Good fortune. Commands trust even from petty people.
lines.meaning: The noble person can be delivered from bondage. Good fortune. Can also inspire trust in petty people.

lines.text: The prince shoots a falcon on a high wall. Catches it. Nothing is not advantageous.
lines.meaning: Shooting down a large hawk from a high wall. Clear and decisive in purpose. Nothing is disadvantageous.

aspects.事業: Unexpected opportunities, require cautious judgment
aspects.感情: Chance encounter, need to observe clearly before deciding
aspects.健康: Pay attention to respiratory system, guard against external pathogens
aspects.財運: Unexpected sources of wealth, require careful evaluation

lines.text: 係于金柅，貞吉，有攸往，見凶，羸豕孚蹢躅
lines.meaning: Firmly bound with metal constraints; adherence to uprightness brings good fortune. Rushing forward will lead to misfortune.

lines.text: 包有魚，無咎，不利賓
lines.meaning: There is a fish in the package, no blame; but it is not suitable for entertaining guests.

lines.text: 臀無膚，其行次且，厲，無大咎
lines.meaning: Sitting uneasily, moving slowly; there is danger, but no great fault.

lines.text: 包無魚，起凶
lines.meaning: No fish in the package, loss of support; misfortune is rising.

lines.text: 以杞包瓜，含章，有隕自天
lines.meaning: Wrapping a melon with mulberry leaves; inner virtue is contained, blessings fall from heaven.

lines.text: 姤其角，吝，無咎
lines.meaning: Encountering at the farthest corner; though there is regret, there is no great fault.

lines.text: If trust is not maintained to the end, then there is disorder and scatteredness. If one cries out, and then gathers with a smile, have no worries. Going forth brings no blame.
lines.meaning: If sincerity cannot last, there will be chaos. If one can call out and gather, turning sorrow into joy, going forth brings no blame.

lines.text: Being led is auspicious, no blame. Sincerity then makes the simple sacrifice beneficial.
lines.meaning: Being led to gather, auspicious and no blame. A simple sacrifice made with sincerity is sufficient.

lines.text: Gathering with sighs and lamentations, no advantage. Going forth brings no blame, but there is a slight regret.
lines.meaning: There are sighs and lamentations within the gathering, no advantage. Going forth brings no blame, but there is a slight regret.

lines.text: Great auspiciousness, no blame.
lines.meaning: Great auspiciousness, no fault.

lines.text: Gathering in a position, no blame. If not trusted, maintain primal, eternal perseverance, regret vanishes.
lines.meaning: Gathering in a proper position, no blame. If not trusted, maintain righteousness for a long time, regret will vanish.

lines.text: Weeping, sighing, shedding tears; no blame.
lines.meaning: Weeping and sighing, though sad, there is no blame. Emotions are genuinely expressed.

lines.text: Sincere ascent, great good fortune.
lines.meaning: Rising with sincerity and trustworthiness, great good fortune.

lines.text: With sincerity, it is beneficial to use a simple sacrifice; no blame.
lines.meaning: With sincerity, offer a simple sacrifice; no blame; sincerity is better than formality.

lines.text: Ascending to an empty city.
lines.meaning: Entering an empty and uninhabited city, moving freely without obstruction.

lines.text: The King uses it to make offerings at Mount Qi; good fortune, no blame.
lines.meaning: The King makes offerings at Mount Qi; auspicious and without blame; ascending by the right path.

lines.text: Perseverance brings good fortune; ascending the steps.
lines.meaning: Adhering to correctness brings good fortune; ascending step by step, making steady progress one step at a time.

lines.text: Ascending in darkness; favorable for unceasing perseverance.
lines.meaning: Continuously ascending in obscurity/darkness; favorable for unceasing adherence to correctness.

lines.text: The buttocks are stuck on a stump, entering a dark valley, for three years unseen
lines.meaning: Trapped beneath a withered tree, fallen into a dark, secluded valley, for three years no light is seen.

lines.text: Distressed by wine and food, a high-ranking official is about to arrive. It is favorable to offer sacrifices. Campaigning is inauspicious, but there will be no blame.
lines.meaning: Distressed by wine and food, a high official will arrive. It is beneficial for offerings and sacrifices; marching forward is ominous.

lines.text: Distressed by rocks, leaning on caltrops. Entering one's palace, one does not see one's wife. Inauspicious.
lines.meaning: Trapped by a boulder, leaning on thorny caltrops, returning home yet not seeing one's wife; ominous.

lines.text: Comes slowly, distressed by a golden carriage. Regret, but there will be an end.
lines.meaning: Coming slowly, trapped by a golden carriage; though there is regret, there will be a resolution.

lines.text: Nose cut off and feet amputated. Distressed by a red sash. Gradually there is joy. It is favorable to offer sacrifices.
lines.meaning: Suffering penal mutilation, trapped in a high position, then slowly finding release; it is beneficial for sacrifices.

lines.text: Distressed by creepers, in an unstable situation. If one repents and acts, there will be regret, but campaigning will be auspicious.
lines.meaning: Trapped by creeping vines, in a precarious and unstable state. If one repents and acts, marching forward will be auspicious.

011010.name: The Well Hexagram

aspects.感情: Stable nourishment, long-lasting companionship.

lines.text: The well mud cannot be eaten; the old well has no birds.
lines.meaning: The muddy bottom of the well is unusable for drinking; an abandoned well, not even birds or beasts come to it, indicating discarded talent.

lines.text: Water from the well valley can only shoot minnows; the jar is broken and leaks.
lines.meaning: The well water is only enough for shooting fish; the water bucket is broken and leaks, indicating talent not being well utilized.

lines.text: The well is clean, but no one drinks from it; this grieves my heart. It can be drawn from. If a king is enlightened, all will receive its blessings.
lines.meaning: The well water is clear but no one draws from it, which is heartbreaking. An enlightened ruler can recognize and utilize talent.

lines.text: The well is bricked; no blame.
lines.meaning: Repairing the well wall, no blame; self-cultivation and enrichment.

lines.text: The well is clear; cold spring water is drunk.
lines.meaning: The well water is clear and pure, cool sweet spring water for people to drink; talent and virtue are widely spread.

lines.text: The well is completed; do not cover it. There is sincerity; great good fortune.
lines.meaning: The well is finished; do not cover it. Let sincerity flow freely; great auspiciousness.

lines.text: The cauldron is overturned, beneficial to pour out what is stale, obtain a concubine and her son, no blame.
lines.meaning: The cauldron's legs are pointing upwards, pouring out stale things, removing the old and bringing in the new, no blame.

lines.text: The cauldron has substance, my enemy has an illness, unable to approach me, auspicious.
lines.meaning: The cauldron is full, the opponent is sick and cannot harm me, auspicious.

lines.text: The cauldron's ears are altered, its movement is hindered, pheasant fat is not eaten, temporary regret due to rain, ultimately auspicious.
lines.meaning: The cauldron's ears are changed, actions are blocked, pheasant fat cannot be eaten temporarily, eventually auspicious.

lines.text: The cauldron breaks its leg, overturning the duke's broth, its form is drenched, inauspicious.
lines.meaning: The cauldron's leg breaks, the delicious food is overturned, looking disheveled, inauspicious.

lines.text: The cauldron has yellow ears and golden suspension rods, beneficial to be firm and correct.
lines.meaning: The cauldron has golden ears and golden suspension rods, adhering to correctness is beneficial, virtue and talent are matched.

lines.text: The cauldron has jade suspension rods, great auspiciousness, nothing disadvantageous.
lines.meaning: The cauldron has jade suspension rods, a symbol of supreme honor, great auspiciousness with nothing disadvantageous.

001001.name: Keeping Still (Gèn)

aspects.感情: Maintain appropriate distance, quietly await fate.
aspects.健康: Rest and recuperate, pay attention to muscles, bones, and spine.
aspects.財運: Pause investments, observe changes quietly.

lines.text: Keeping still at his toes, no blame, advantageous for perpetual perseverance.
lines.meaning: Stopping at the toes, stopping early, no blame, perpetual uprightness is advantageous.

lines.text: Keeping still at his calves, he cannot save his follower, his heart is displeased.
lines.meaning: Stopping at the calves, unable to rescue companions, feeling unhappy in one's heart.

lines.text: Keeping still at his waist, splitting his spine, danger consumes his heart.
lines.meaning: Stopping at the waist, spine splitting apart, danger makes one anxious.

lines.text: Keeping still at his trunk/body, no blame.
lines.meaning: Stopping with the whole body, complete stillness, no blame.

lines.text: Keeping still at his jaw/mouth, words have order, regret vanishes.
lines.meaning: Stopping at the jaw/mouth, words are orderly, regret disappears.

lines.text: Magnanimous stillness, auspicious.
lines.meaning: Stopping with profound sincerity, auspicious, substantial stillness brings stability.

lines.meaning: The wild goose gradually approaches the water's edge; the young one is in danger; although there is talk, there is no fault.

lines.text: The wild goose gradually advances to the rock; it eats and drinks joyfully; auspicious.
lines.meaning: The wild goose gradually approaches the solid rock; it eats and drinks peacefully and contentedly; auspicious.

lines.text: The wild goose gradually advances to the dry land; the husband goes on an expedition and does not return; the wife is pregnant but does not give birth; inauspicious. It is advantageous to guard against robbers.
lines.meaning: The wild goose gradually approaches the land; the husband leaves and does not return; the wife is pregnant but finds it difficult to bear children; inauspicious. But it is advantageous to defend against external enemies.

lines.text: The wild goose gradually advances to the trees; perhaps it finds a suitable branch; no blame.
lines.meaning: The wild goose gradually approaches the trees; perhaps it finds a suitable branch to perch on; no blame.

lines.text: The wild goose gradually advances to the high mound; the wife does not conceive for three years; ultimately, no one can hinder this; auspicious.
lines.meaning: The wild goose gradually approaches the high mound; the woman does not conceive for three years; ultimately, no one can hinder this; auspicious.

lines.text: The wild goose gradually advances to the high land; its feathers can be used for ceremonial adornment; auspicious.
lines.meaning: The wild goose gradually approaches a high place; its feathers can be used for ceremonial decorations; auspicious.

lines.text: The wanderer reaches a lodging, holding his resources, obtains a young servant, righteous.
lines.meaning: Obtaining lodging during the journey, keeping money and property, getting a servant, maintaining righteousness.

lines.text: The wanderer's lodging is burned, he loses his young servant, righteousness is perilous.
lines.meaning: The travel lodging is burned, losing the servant, even maintaining righteousness is dangerous.

lines.text: The wanderer is in a place, obtains resources and axes, but my heart is not pleased.
lines.meaning: Obtaining a place to settle and resources during the journey, but still feeling uneasy in the heart.

lines.text: Shooting a pheasant, one arrow is lost, eventually achieving a reputation of honor.
lines.meaning: Shooting a wild pheasant, losing an arrow, ultimately gaining a destiny of honor.

lines.text: The bird's nest is burned, the wanderer first laughs then wails, loses a cow in an easy place, inauspicious.
lines.meaning: The bird's nest is burned, the wanderer first laughs then cries, losing a cow in an easy place, inauspicious.

lines.meaning: Humbly prostrating under the bed, seeking prayer through spiritual practitioners; auspicious, no blame

lines.text: Frequent gentleness, regrettable
lines.meaning: Repeated humility, excessive submissiveness, leads to regret

lines.text: Regret vanishes, the field yields three kinds of game

lines.text: Righteousness brings auspiciousness, regret vanishes, nothing is unfavorable, without beginning but with an end, three days before Geng, three days after Geng, auspicious
lines.meaning: Upholding righteousness brings auspiciousness, regret disappears, nothing is unfavorable; though without a beginning, there is a good ending

lines.text: Gentleness under the bed, losing one's resources and axe, righteousness brings misfortune
lines.meaning: Excessive humility prostrating under the bed, losing resources; even upholding righteousness brings misfortune

lines.text: Using strong horses to rescue, auspicious.

lines.text: In dispersion, hastening to what one relies on, regret vanishes.

lines.text: Dispelling one's personal desires, no regret.
lines.meaning: Dispelling one's personal desires, no regret, public-spirited and forgetting oneself.

lines.text: Dispelling small groups, supremely auspicious, forming a mound (larger gathering), beyond ordinary comprehension.

lines.text: Dispelling one's blood (harm/fear), going far away, no blame.

lines.meaning: Overlooks the grandfather, meets the grandmother; does not reach the ruler, meets the minister; remaining content in one's place, no blame.

lines.text: Does not exceed but guards against it; following may lead to harm, misfortune.
lines.meaning: Without precaution, one will suffer harm; misfortune.

lines.text: No blame. Does not exceed but meets it. Going brings danger, must be cautious. Do not use perpetual perseverance.
lines.meaning: No blame. Stop when appropriate. Going forward carries danger, must be cautious. Cannot hold on forever.

lines.text: Dense clouds without rain, from our western suburbs. The duke shoots and takes a bird in its nest.
lines.meaning: Dense clouds without rain, coming from the west. The duke shoots a bird in its nest; the time is not yet ripe.

lines.text: Does not meet but exceeds it. The flying bird leaves it. Misfortune. This is called calamity and disaster.
lines.meaning: Exceeding but failing to meet; the flying bird departs. Misfortune. This is called calamity.
